description:
The Find My team builds a seamless, private, and secure way for people to locate their devices and personal items — and share location with friends and family — at a scale of hundreds of millions of users worldwide. We're a fast-paced, collaborative group of engineers, designers, and product managers who wear many hats and partner across hardware, software, and privacy to ship groundbreaking, reliable experiences.

Description
As an SDET on the Find My team, you'll thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment, owning test strategy and automation across the stack — backend services and web — for features that reach hundreds of millions of users. You'll partner closely with engineers to shift testing left, build reliable automation into our CI/CD pipelines, and continuously raise the bar on quality as we build the future of Find My.

AI readiness: We expect our SDETs to be fluent with modern AI tooling — comfortable using GenAI and AI-assisted coding/testing tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) to accelerate test authoring, triage, and coverage, with sound judgment about where AI helps and where human verification is essential.

Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks across backend services and web for Find My
Automate API / microservice testing — functional, contract, integration, and performance — for the services that power Find My
Build and maintain web UI automation (e.g. Playwright) for Find My's browser experiences
Deconstruct complex, cross-layer features into comprehensive, risk-based test plans and convert them into reliable automated tests
Partner with developers early to shift testing left — influencing testability, catching defects sooner, and reducing manual effort
Build, monitor, and continuously improve CI/CD test pipelines to keep the suite fast, stable, and trustworthy
Investigate failures across the stack, file clear and actionable defects, and drive them to resolution with the right data and reproduction steps
Validate functionality, reliability, and privacy across browsers, environments, and network conditions
Explore and adopt GenAI and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate test creation, triage, and coverage
Report quality signals and risk clearly to the team to support confident release decisions
Collaborate cross-functionally with technical and non-technical partners across Apple

Minimum qualifications
5+ years of experience in software quality engineering / test, with a strong automation focus
Hands-on automation experience across backend/API and web (breadth across both strongly preferred)
Proficiency in at least one object-oriented language (Java, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or equivalent)
Experience automating API / microservice testing (unit, component, integration, contract tests) and working with REST/JSON
Experience with web UI automation (Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress)
Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, testing methodologies, and the test pyramid
Experience designing test plans, assessing risk, filing defects, and reporting test results
Experience building and maintaining automated test suites that scale
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and version control
BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
Comfortable using AI / GenAI-assisted development and testing tools (e.g. Claude, Copilot) in day-to-day work
Strong written and verbal communication — able to report quality status and risk clearly to technical and non-technical partners

Preferred qualifications
Modern web automation frameworks (i.e. Playwright) and cross-browser testing
Backend/REST API testing depth: contract testing tools, service virtualization, mocking, performance/load testing
Experience testing location-, privacy-, or security-sensitive features
Familiarity with observability and monitoring (logs, metrics, tracing) to diagnose service failures
Experience with containerized test environments and cloud-based test infrastructure
Exposure to Kubernetes, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure
Understanding of operating systems and networking fundamentals
Experience with CI/CD and the build & release process for web / service projects
Passion for clean code and OO design patterns
Enthusiastic about Apple and genuinely passionate about the customer experience
Able to cut through ambiguity and deliver results on time
